newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's to sell stores, take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's to sell stores, take Q4 charge.

text.p: Proffitt's Inc said Wednesday it will sell seven of its stores in Virginia to Dillard Department Stores Inc and take a fourth quarter after-tax charge of about $2 million for closing the stores.
The retailer said the deal should close in March 1997 and that the move should improve its future operating results.

"Over the last three years, we have sought to expand our presence in Virginia through acquisition, but we have been unable to do so. Consequently, we believe our interests are best served by focusing our efforts and resources in other markets," Chief Executive R. Brad Martin said in a release.
